newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to remain mixed on Wednesday, the settlement day, on selling pressure by speculators, but the index may end up on select blue chips, dealers said.
"Telecom utility PTCL, which has a heavy weightage in the Karachi index, is likely to remain in demand, which will push the index up," dealer Rony Byramjee said.
"But overall sentiment will be mixed and losers are likely to outnumber the advancers, as on Tuesday."
On Tuesday, the index rose 27.13 points, or 1.73 percent, to end at 1,592.86. Losers led gainers by 216 to 84.
Turnover rose to 53.34 million shares from 34.50 million in the previous session.
